name: io.github.Zof-AI/zof-mcp-server
title: Zof MCP server
description: Six read-only local tools for change verification, impact, evidence, policy and test suggestions.

packageArguments.description: Absolute path to one existing, narrowly scoped local project directory. Filesystem roots and the home directory are rejected. Linux/macOS file operations require Python 3.10+.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: No authentication or Zof account; local stdio only.
limitations: No HTTP transport, hosted Zof integration, shell execution or source upload.
Static verification does not establish that tests were executed.
The host fixes the workspace at startup; tool calls cannot change it.
